report_metadata.title: OMNIVERSEOS 2.0 MASTER FORENSIC RE-AUDIT & RECONCILED PRODUCT ROADMAP

executive_summary.rationale: Zero P0 defects, zero P1 defects unresolved. All 32 desktop applications verified via live browser automation with zero crash boundaries. All 32 mobile applications verified across 5 responsive viewports with zero horizontal overflow. User Windows Phone mobile revamp verified 100% operational. Pytest backend suite verified (29 passed, 1 skipped out of 30 total; skipped test is test_ai_image due to unconfigured Gemini API key). Jest frontend suite passing 100% (20 suites, 82 passed). Raw AI evaluations reconciled: 121 passed, 15 factual unverifiable without web key, 14 not applicable, 0 failed. Real media bytes verified: 26,471 B JPEG and 176,444 B WAV. DEF-001 through DEF-006 resolved. Release is CONDITIONAL on configuring a durable MongoDB cluster connection string (since local dev uses ephemeral mongomock) and providing TINYFISH_API_KEY for live web search.

release_gates.gate_0_core_stability: PASSED (FastAPI port 8001, React port 3000, production build clean)
release_gates.gate_2_responsive_forensics: PASSED (5 viewports, 32 apps, zero overflow, Windows Phone Metro verified)
release_gates.gate_3_automated_regressions: PASSED (82/82 Jest pass, 29/30 Pytest pass with 1 skipped)
release_gates.gate_4_durable_persistence: CONDITIONAL (Local mongomock is in-memory; production enforces live MongoDB)
release_gates.gate_5_live_web_search: BLOCKED (TINYFISH_API_KEY unconfigured; local knowledge fallback active)
release_gates.gate_6_media_bytes: PASSED (26,471 B JPEG and 176,444 B WAV verified)
